To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the brain is a machine that makes the mind.
1) the brain and the body are not separate entities, 2) the brain does not work alone, and 3) the mind is not separate from the body and brain.
(a) The human brain is a complex, highly integrated network of specialized brain areas that work together to produce the mind.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of the brain and the body in the development of the mind.
understanding the neural mechanisms that underlie the ability to learn and remember information.
the role of the body in cognitive processing, and with how our bodies are shaped and constrained by the world around us.

the book Being There is an outstanding work that should be read by everyone. It is a book about the nature of mind and the nature of the world.
Being There is a very important work that will be of interest to all who have an interest in the philosophy of mind, cognitive science, and the philosophy of science.
this is a book which will change your way of thinking about thinking.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are not just brains in vats, but brains in bodies in worlds.
we are not just a mind in a box. We are not just a brain.

the brain is a control system for a body that is deeply embedded in a rich and structured environment.
